cell.label: Aspergillosis clinically suspected. Order chest x-ray. Focal infiltrate or nodule?
Order sputum culture, serum galactomannam (GMA) and serum beta-D-glucan (BDG). Positive sputum or GMA?
Order chest CT. Focal nodule or infiltrate?
Probable aspergillosis. Start voriconazole (amphotericin is alternate).
Start voriconazole with or without echinocandin.
All results negative. Consider biopsy/bronch for tissue diagnosis.
Repeat CT if symptoms persist; consider empiric therapy if fever continues.
